chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
"Indeed, upon the top of every camel there is a devil, so feed it well and keep it subdued."

key_terms.امْتَهِنْهُ: keep it subdued and under control
key_terms.شَيْطَانًا: a devil; here indicating harmful unruliness or danger

ai.seo_question: What did Imam عليه السلام say about handling and caring for camels?
ai.summary: The Imam عليه السلام teaches proper conduct in dealing with camels, warning of the difficulty and unruliness associated with them. The instruction is to care for the animal by feeding it adequately while also keeping it disciplined and under control.
